title: Joint Association
description: Associates a target joint vocabulary entry with a source glTF node.

node.description: Index of the source joint's glTF node in the nodes array.
node.gltf_detailedDescription: This value MUST be a valid index into the `nodes` array.

name.description: The name of the source joint node.
name.gltf_detailedDescription: When defined, this value MUST exactly match the `name` property of the node referenced by `node`.
